defs.def: high in rank or status; higher in rank or status than others 级别（或地位）高的
for adults or people at a more advanced level 成人的；高级水平的

ex.s: “We didn’t make a big deal of that,” said Novem Auyeung, a Parks Department senior scientist.
ex.t: “我们当时没把那当回事，”公园管理局高级科学家Novem Auyeung说。

defs.def: for senior citizens (= older people, especially those who have retired from work) 年纪大的；老年的；年老的

ex.s: It reserves seats for the seniors.

defs.def: （父子同名时，加在父亲的名字前）老

ex.s: To all, I wish a pleasant trip, to groups off for a family wedding in Singapore, to seniors travelling to Rome for holiday, to children off to Disney World in Orlando...the airport is not a dull place.
ex.t: 祝所有人旅途愉快，无论是前往新加坡参加家族婚礼的团体、去罗马度假的老人，还是出发去奥兰多迪士尼乐园的孩子……机场不是个沉闷的地方。

defs.def: for children over the age of 11 or 13 学校或其分部

ex.s: That way, you’ll make the most your time at senior high.” People say, “Well begun, half done.” I guess this was a good beginning to my new school life.
ex.t: 那样的话，你就会充分利用你的高中时光。"人们说："好的开始是成功的一半。"我想这是我对新学校生活的一个良好开端。

defs.def: connected with the last year in high school or college （高中或大学）毕业年级的

ex.s: Your Form Teacher 1 How did you feel on your first day at senior high?
ex.t: 你的班主任 1 你高中第一天感觉如何？

ex.s: But this is just the kind of thing you are going to face at senior high.
ex.t: 但这正是你在高中将要面对的那种事。

defs.def: a person who is older than sb else 较 … 年长的人
a person who is higher in rank or status 级别（或地位）较高者；上级；上司
adults or people who have reached an advanced level 资深成人运动员；高水平运动员

ex.s: “We usually think in very concrete terms when doing something on a screen,” said Simone Schnall, senior author of the study.
ex.t: “我们在屏幕上做事情时，通常用非常具体的方式思考，”该研究的主要作者Simone Schnall说。

ex.s: And for that to happen, we also need to protect nature so that we can interact with it,” said Peter Kahn, a senior author of the study.
ex.t: 而要做到这一点，我们还需要保护自然，这样我们才能与之互动，该研究的资深作者彼得·卡恩说。

defs.def: a child at a senior school; an older child in a school 中学生；高年级学生

ex.s: I talked to one of the senior applicants who answered questions in a way that reflected the faith she had in herself.
ex.t: 我和一位高年级申请者交谈，她回答问题时展现出对自己的信心。

ex.s: This year, with an open mind and new knowledge in mind, I walked into another group interview while telling myself I was that cool senior.
ex.t: 今年，带着开放的心态和新知，我走进另一次小组面试，告诉自己我就是那个从容的高年级生。

defs.def: (in the US and some other countries) a student in the last year at a high school or college （美国等若干国家高中和大学的）毕业班学生

ex.s: To help them do this, some senior high schools offer courses in time management.
ex.t: 为了帮助他们做到这一点，一些高中开设了时间管理课程。
